'''''Arturum Galactinum''''' was a work by the historian [[Vicendi]] in [[10,000 BBY]]. It was commissioned for the anniversary of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and featured a list of the [[Twenty Wonders of the Galaxy]].
